name: Tm Visualization Suite: Multivariate Explorer
pitch: Compare two to twelve measures for each observation with matrices and parallel coordinates.
question: Which measures move together, and which observations stand apart?
useWhen: Compare several measures when each row is one observation.
features: Read the Pearson coefficient for every pair of measures in one grid.
Compare every pair of measures in a scatterplot matrix.
Follow each observation across many measures as one line.
Map up to twelve measures in one ordered set of slots.
Sample evenly with a notice when the result holds more observations.
See selected and excluded marks by a tick or a dashed outline.

hero.alt: Correlation matrix of ten store measures with the coefficient in each cell and a diverging color.

screenshots.alt: Scatterplot matrix of six store measures with one dot for each store month in every panel.
screenshots.caption: Compare every pair of measures at one time.
